title: Predication settling
description: JSON Schema for a predication settling — a family v = (v_τ)_{τ < λ} of predication valuations indexed by ordinals up to a settling bound λ, satisfying settling monotonicity v_σ(p) ≤_k v_τ(p) for σ ≤ τ < λ pointwise in A_p. The fundamental dynamic object: a trajectory of valuations in the knowledge order under a closure operator. Stored as the bound λ and the indexed list of valuations. Settling monotonicity is runtime-checked; the schema captures the shape only.

bound.description: The settling bound λ as a non-negative integer. The valuations array has exactly λ entries indexed by ordinals τ = 0, 1, …, λ-1.

valuations.description: The indexed family (v_τ). valuations[τ] is the valuation at settling step τ. Verifier checks length equals bound and v_σ ≤_k v_τ pointwise for σ ≤ τ.

closure-operator-slug.description: Optional slug naming the closure operator whose action generates this settling. Reference into code/transformers/.
